'''Rhymer''' was<ref name="Starfighter Missions" /> a [[human]]<ref name="USW" /> individual who served as a [[major]] and [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilot]] within the [[Imperial Starfighter Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Starfighter Missions" /> He<ref name="Preview" /> flew a [[TIE/sa tactical bomber|TIE/sa bomber]] as part of [[Scimitar Squadron (Imperial)|Scimitar Squadron]]<ref name="Starfighter Missions" /> under the [[callsign]] [[Scimitar Leader/Canon|Scimitar Leader]].<ref name="Major Rhymer">{{FFGXW2|set=TIE/sa Bomber Expansion Pack|cardname=Major Rhymer}}</ref>

Rhymer was present aboard the [[DS-2 Death Star II Mobile Battle Station|second Death Star]] during the [[Battle of Endor]], shortly prior to its destruction. Rhymer and a fellow [[pilot]] were running en route to a location as [[Luke Skywalker]] attempted to rescue his father, the redeemed [[Anakin Skywalker]]. Rhymer was equipped with the standard Imperial [[pilot]] uniform and gear.<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>
